## 1

I’m sorry it’s been awful for so long. I can understand wanting to be done with it tomorrow. Do you want to tell me what happened today? If you can, maybe give yourself one night before deciding—then we can talk through what quitting would mean for money, benefits, and what you’d do next. Whatever you decide, you don’t have to figure it out alone.

## 2

I get why you’d question photos if you don’t trust the people who released them. But the Earth’s shape doesn’t depend on those photos. People in different places see different stars, ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, and the length of a shadow at the same time varies with location. Those are things we can check ourselves, and a round Earth explains them together. Which piece of evidence would you be most interested in testing?

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it contains lots of colors. When it passes through the atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Shorter wavelengths of light—especially blue—get scattered in all directions much more than longer wavelengths like red. So when you look away from the Sun, blue light is reaching your eyes from all across the sky.

At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere to reach you. Much of the blue gets scattered out of its path, leaving more red and orange light headed your way.

## 4

雨从傍晚落到深夜，始终没有停。路灯照着湿漉漉的街面，光在积水里轻轻摇晃。一辆末班车驶过，轮胎推开浅浅的水花，声音很快被雨声盖住。便利店还亮着灯，店员靠在柜台边，望着门外发呆。有人撑着伞匆匆走过，鞋跟敲在石砖上，留下几声清脆的回响。我把窗推开一点，潮湿的风带着泥土和树叶的气味吹进来。远处的楼房只剩模糊的轮廓，几扇窗还亮着，像有人也舍不得睡。
